description: Replacement of existing conservatory to rear, door and window adjustments at ground floor level and installation of 2Nos. roof lights with air-conditioning unit on first floor roof.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location PlanExisting Block Plan 003.001 Rev PL1Proposed Block Plan 004.001 Rev PL1003.100 Rev PL1003.110 Rev PL1003.120 Rev PL1003.200 Rev PL1003.300 Rev PL1003.310 Rev PL1003.320 Rev PL1003.330 Rev PL1004.100 Rev PL1004.110 Rev PL1004.120 Rev PL1004.200 Rev PL1004.300 Rev PL1004.310 Rev PL1004.320 Rev PL1004.330 Rev PL1Environmental Boise assessment - Clear Acoustic Design Revision 17 September 2025Design, Access and Heritage StatementReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be in materials to match the existing building or carried out in materials as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

Prior to any above ground works, details of the proposed materials including, new timber frame windows and conservation style rooflight shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall be a scale of 1:20 with 1:5 sections (including cills, reveals, heads, window furniture). The proposed windows shall be installed in accordance with the approved details prior to occupation. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance in the Meadway Conservation Area.
